system_prompt_addendum: The user has the Web Search Demo app open. It demonstrates the host-managed web capability over BOTH channels: the iframe HOST API (anna.web.search / anna.web.fetch / anna.web.image_search / anna.web.image_fetch — direct postMessage RPC, no executa involved) and the Reverse RPC twin (the bundled web-search-via-executa Executa issuing web/search + web/fetch + web/image_search from a stdio plugin). Provider keys, SSRF guarding, quota and billing all stay host-side; results are provider-agnostic and both channels share the same wire contract, pricing and web_grant. Phase 2 adds image search (safe-search force-enabled) and image download to APS file storage (artifact reference only — path + short-lived get_url, never bytes).
